rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Key2OAuth is a Cloudflare Workers adapter that enables OAuth 2.1 clients like Claude.ai and Cursor to connect to MCP servers that only support API key authentication. It encrypts API keys at rest using AES-GCM, provides a user-friendly in-browser paste page for API key entry, and implements standard OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and token refresh. Built on the Hono framework, it supports one-click deployment to Cloudflare Workers.
